summary: Spoke to the owner, Reem. She liked that the site uses her own nail photos and wants the link on WhatsApp to show her partner. Asked about price.

data.objection: wants to know the monthly price

transcript.said: Hi, this is FRIDAY, an AI assistant calling from your company. Am I speaking with the owner or manager of Glow Lab Nails?
Yes, this is Reem, I'm the owner.
Thanks Reem. You have great reviews and you post a lot on Instagram, but no website, so we built you a free demo with your own photos and online booking. Can I send you the link?
Oh nice. Send it on WhatsApp, same number. How much is it?
The team will send the details with the link. Is a website something you'd consider?
Yes, if the price is fine. I'll show my partner.
Perfect, I'll send it now. Thanks Reem, have a lovely day.
